statement: Clean execution and diagnosis of the frozen prospective external cohort. Run 001 was voided (VOID_RUN_001/) for a QUTest gate-vocabulary incompatibility and its case-level outputs were not consulted during Run 002.

consistency.zero_endpoint_partition: 152 with max_universe_d_a <= 1e-9 = CL1(28)+CL2(94)+CL3(30); 118 above theta = KILLED(111)+CL4(5)+Unresolved(2)
consistency.regeneration: diag re-run from the frozen L2 ledger reproduced L3/L4/L5 byte-identically
consistency.seed_reproducibility: independent re-execution of the native stage into a separate directory reproduced all 270 native verdicts, all 270 kill counts, and all 3240 per-repetition seeds and verdicts exactly; outcome digest 3b44d68e7937b40a48ed07ea15bb9531e289333d3e243f7f11c1a4c89f13eee2 matches

technical_failures.description: csv.DictWriter fieldnames were taken from the first row only. KILLED rows carry an empty evidence dict, so when a KILLED row led the evidence ledger the OB01-OB19 columns were absent and later rows raised ValueError. L4_EVIDENCE.csv was written truncated and L5_CERTIFICATES.csv was never written.
technical_failures.scope: write-serialization only; no relation, evidence or certificate value was affected
technical_failures.fix: fieldnames computed as the union of all row keys, restval=''
technical_failures.resolution: diag re-run from the unchanged frozen L2 ledger; all three ledgers written at 270 rows and byte-identical across two successive runs
technical_failures.outcomes_inspected_before_fix: none - the certificates ledger did not exist

technical_failures.description: The ledgers were first written with the csv module's default CRLF terminator. Under this repository's core.autocrlf=input the committed blobs are LF-normalized, so the recorded working-copy hashes would not reproduce from a fresh clone.
technical_failures.scope: line terminators only; no field value was affected
technical_failures.fix: runner writes lineterminator='\n'; diag re-run from the unchanged frozen L2 ledger
technical_failures.resolution: regenerated ledgers are byte-identical to the CRLF versions after line-ending normalization, and their recorded hashes now equal the committed blob hashes

technical_failures.description: L2_NATIVE.jsonl stores QUTest's raw per-repetition output string, which embeds elapsed wall-clock time. The whole-file sha256 therefore does not reproduce across runs even though every outcome does.
technical_failures.scope: the timing substring of the 'detail' field only; 2039 of 3240 repetition records differ in that substring and in nothing else
technical_failures.fix: the executed ledger is left exactly as recorded; a timing-independent outcome digest over all outcome-bearing fields is recorded in L2_OUTCOME_DIGEST.txt
technical_failures.resolution: outcome digest matches between two independent executions

note_on_CL5: CL5 requires eps_num < max_universe_d_a <= theta. The cohort's endpoint differences are bimodal: 152 cases at <= 2.554e-15 and 118 at >= 0.5, with no case in between. The CL5 band is empty by the structure of these circuits, not by a missing measurement.

runner.invocation: must be run with the study tree confirmatory/ as cwd and on PYTHONPATH; archived here, not left in the read-only study tree
runner.note: Ledgers are written with LF line terminators so the recorded hashes survive a git clone under core.autocrlf=input.
